title: rosa × sabinii f. sabauda
intro: Rosa × sabinii f. sabauda, commonly known as the Sabauda rose, is a variety of hybrid rose that is known for its fragrant and showy flowers. The health benefits of Rosa × sabinii f. sabauda include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant are believed to be due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, and have been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote relaxation and reduce stress. However, more research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic actions and bioactive constituents of Rosa × sabinii f. sabauda.
